_about: Points and miles for ConcordeGo, researched 2026-09-24 from the banks' and airlines' own pages where they could be read, and from dated secondary sources where they could not (each chart says which). Each research file was checked by a second reader and its corrections applied. Award charts are the published PRICE of a seat if one is released; no chart says a seat is available. Built by the lead session; change a figure only with its source.

valuation.month: September 2026. Source: TPG, 'What are points and miles worth? TPG's Sept. 2026 valuations', published 2026-09-01, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-09-24. TPG publishes no value for Lufthansa Miles & More. That row is left out on purpose: the value is unknown, not zero. TPG's 'Capital One' row is used for Capital One Miles, 'Bilt' for Bilt Rewards and 'Avios' for British Airways Avios.

ba-own.name: British Airways' own flights
ba-own.as_of: Head for Points table 'How many Avios do you need to fly to ....?' by Rob Burgess, published 2026-08-01, modified 2026-08-31 (https://www.headforpoints.com/2026/08/01/how-many-avios-do-you-need-to-fly-to/); reflects the 2025-12-15 Avios increase and the 2026-05-27 cash increase
ba-own.fees: plus BA's fixed cash charge per flight, several hundred dollars across the Atlantic (AwardWallet)

ba-partner.name: British Airways Avios on one partner airline
ba-partner.as_of: Verylvke, 'BA Avios partner award devaluation (full chart included)', 2025-12-19 (https://www.verylvke.com/en/2025/12/19/ba-avios-partner-award-devaluation-full-chart-included/); zones 1-4 corroborated by The MileLion, 2025-12-16 (https://milelion.com/2025/12/16/details-british-airways-avios-award-devaluation/); per flight and additive, and within North America the first band prices as the second (The MileLion, 2025-12-16)
ba-partner.fees: plus the airline's taxes and charges, which vary by airline and route
ba-partner.caveat: American and Alaska: the two sources disagree below 3,000 miles; this uses the higher

status_bags._about: Free checked bags a status gives, from each airline's own pages (research 2026-09-24, checked by a second reader). 'total' means that many bags free in all; 'extra' means that many more than the fare includes. Applied to the member's own bags only; many programmes extend it to companions on the same booking.
